meta.name: ilspy-decompile
meta.description: Understand implementation details of .NET code by decompiling assemblies. Use when you want to see how a .NET API works internally, inspect NuGet package source, view framework implementation, or understand compiled .NET binaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 反编译 .NET 程序集来理解内部实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想查看 .NET 库或 NuGet 包的源代码
copy.tagline_en: Decompile .NET assemblies to inspect internal implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to view source code of .NET libraries or NuGet packages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以反编译.NET程序集（.dll文件），并把编译后的二进制代码还原成可读的C#源码，让你看到类、方法等内部实现。
howto.when: 当你询问某个.NET API的内部工作原理、想查看NuGet包源码、框架实现或理解编译后的二进制代码时触发。

say.text: 反编译 System.Text.Json.dll，看看它的内部实现。
列出 MyLibrary.dll 中的所有类。
say.note: Claude会使用 -l c 参数列出类名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can decompile .NET assemblies (.dll files) and convert compiled binary code back into readable C# source code, revealing internal class and method implementations.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you ask about the internal implementation of a .NET API, want to inspect NuGet package source, view framework code, or understand compiled .NET binaries.

say_en.text: Decompile System.Text.Json.dll and show its internal implementation.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the dll and decompile using ilspycmd to output source code.
Claude will use -l c parameter to list class names.

say_en.text: Decompile the type MyNamespace.MyClass from MyLibrary.dll.
say_en.note: Claude will decompile only the specified type.
